detail.longDescription: Git is supposed to be bad at handling mono repos especially where there are many binary files like game projects repo, and also there are no permisson settings, but are important in game development. BlackGit's cli client lets you download only cared files through sparse-checkout(initially not even the default root files) with a mini agent to use natural languages to manipulate the repo, and blackgit's server serves a file level control layer as a proxy to upstreams(github/gitlab)
